rules.ACTIVE: May be used by new and existing consumers.
rules.DEPRECATED: Replacement must be named; existing consumers may continue during a documented window.
rules.MIGRATION_WINDOW: Migration evidence and compatibility tests are required.
rules.NO_NEW_CONSUMERS: New bindings are rejected; only migration/compatibility work is allowed.
rules.RETIREMENT_READY: Known consumers are migrated and negative lookup confirms no remaining admitted consumers.
rules.RETIRED: Contract is historical only and cannot be selected at runtime.

breakingChangePolicy: Breaking changes require a new contract version and explicit migration path.
